name: TEMPEH TIBS
description: Smiling hora tempeh marinated in Addissae special sauce, then sauteed with onion, garlic, ginger, and green pepper. Choose your side (misir, shiro, ater-kik, gomen, tikel-gomen, defin-misir or salad)

name: MISIR WA’T (Red Lentils)
description: Red lentils simmered in onion, garlic, ginger and rich berbere sauce.

name: ATER KIK W’AT (Yellow Split Pea Stew)
description: Yellow split peas simmered in a mild sauce of onions, garlic, ginger, and turmeric.

name: SHIRO W’AT (Chickpea Stew)
description: Imported Chickpea flour simmered in our unique, mildly seasoned berbere sauce. Served with injera

name: DIFIN MISIR (Brown Lentils Stew)
description: Brown lentils mildly simmered in onion, garlic, ginger, and turmeric.

name: GOMEN (Collard Green)
description: Fresh chopped collard green cooked in onions, garlic, and ginger.

name: TIKEL GOMEN (Cabbage)
description: Fresh cabbage, carrots and potato cooked together with onion, turmeric, ginger, and garlic.

name: KEY SIR (Beets)
description: Fresh beets and carrot cooked together with onion, garlic and ginger.

name: ADDISSAE VEGITERIAN PLATTER
description: Combination of 7 vegan dishes (Misir, Ater-Kik, Shiro, Difin-Misir, Gomen, Tikel-Gomen and Salad)

name: BEEF TIBS
description: Cubes of lean meat sautéed with blended spices, onion, garlic, ginger and green pepper. Cooked to order. Served with injera (3 rolls)

name: LAMB TIBS
description: Cubes of lean meat sautéed with blended spices, onion, garlic, ginger and green pepper. Cooked to order. Served with injera (3 rolls)

name: BEEF KEY W’AT (Spicy Beef Stew)
description: Lean cubed beef simmered in onion, garlic, ginger and spicy berbere sauce.

name: BEEF ALTCHA W’AT (non-spicy beef stew)
description: Lean cubed beef simmered in onion, garlic, ginger and turmeric.

name: KITFO
description: Freshly minced extra lean beef seasoned with Ethiopian spiced butter, Cardamom and Mitmita (red chili powder). Cooked to order. Served with Gomen, Ayib (homemade cottage cheese). (Please check the availability) (Mild, Medium or Spicy)

name: DORO KEY W’AT (CHICKEN)
description: Succulent chicken drumsticks cooked with onion, garlic, ginger and spicy berbere sauce. Served with hard-boiled egg and Ethiopian cottage cheese.

name: GOMEN BESEGA (Collared green with beef)
description: Chopped Collard greens sautéed with lean cubed beef, onions, garlic and ginger.

name: ADDISSAE MEAT PLATTER
description: Combination of Beef kay w’at , Beef Altcha w’at (non-spicy) and Doro kay w’at (chicken). Served with salad.
